         + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

                WHEN cv.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
                WHEN cv.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
            END AS volume_band
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cb.*,
                COUNT(*) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY cb.homefirm, cb.start_month
                ) AS emcv
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    c.filekey,
                    c.homefirm,
                    c.headct,
                    CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
                    CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) AS h1b_dependent,
                    LEFT(c.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
                    date_trunc(
                        'month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')
                    )::DATE AS start_month,
                    cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
                    pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level
                FROM main.cases c
                LEFT JOIN main.case_worksite cw
                    ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
                LEFT JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw
                    ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
            ) cb
        ) cv
    ) cvb

        ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)

       AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
       AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cvb.filekey
        ORDER BY
            (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

           + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,

        ) * CASE p.wage_details -> 'offered_wage' ->> 'unit'

            END AS aow,

        ) * CASE p.wage_details -> 'prevailing_wage' ->> 'unit'
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12

            END AS apw,

          + COALESCE(rule.position_hours, 0.50) * c.headct AS review_hours
    FROM jan_cases c
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT r.base_hours, r.position_hours
        FROM review_schedule r
        WHERE (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*'
               OR r.visa_class = c.visacls::VARCHAR)
          AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*'
               OR r.wage_level = c.wage_level)
          AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*'
               OR r.h1b_dependent = c.h1bdep::VARCHAR)
          AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*'
               OR r.soc_major_group = left(c.soccd, 2))
          AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*'
               OR r.worksite_state = c.wsstate)
          AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*'
               OR r.monthly_volume_band = c.volume_band)
        ORDER BY (
            CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) DESC, r.rule_id ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) rule ON true
)
SELECT
    round(avg(review_hours) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'Yes'), 2) AS yes_average,
    round(avg(review_hours) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'No'), 2) AS no_average
FROM charged;

    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack

        a.headct,
        COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
        COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
    FROM attributes a
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT r.rule_id, r.base_hours, r.position_hours
        FROM review_schedule r
        WHERE (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*'

          AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*'
               OR r.monthly_volume_band = a.volume_band)

              + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*')::INT

WITH wages AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) * CASE pw.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'
            WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
            WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
            WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS offered_annual,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) * CASE pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
            WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
            WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
            WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS prevailing_annual
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-02-01'
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        filekey,
        MIN(100.0 * offered_annual / NULLIF(prevailing_annual, 0))
            AS case_wage_assurance_score
    FROM wages
    GROUP BY filekey
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_count
FROM scores
WHERE case_wage_assurance_score >= 75;

Using the worker-position-weighted average of offered wages as a percentage of prevailing wages, Google LLC’s June 2024 **Employer Wage Assurance Score is 118.78**. On the stated assumption that a score of at least 100 is the “Above prevailing wage” tier, that is its tier. The database does not define official tier thresholds.

```sql
WITH wages AS (
    SELECT
        cw.wsheads,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from',
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS offered,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value',
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS prevailing
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Google LLC'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-06-01'
      AND TRY_STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-07-01'
      AND (p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit')
          = (p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit')
),
score AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(wsheads * 100.0 * offered / NULLIF(prevailing, 0))
            / NULLIF(SUM(wsheads), 0) AS employer_wage_assurance_score
    FROM wages
    WHERE offered IS NOT NULL
      AND prevailing > 0
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN employer_wage_assurance_score >= 100
            THEN 'Above prevailing wage'
        ELSE 'Below prevailing wage'
    END AS tier_name,
    ROUND(employer_wage_assurance_score, 2)
        AS employer_wage_assurance_score
FROM score
```

        ) AS offered,
        TRY_CAST(
            regexp_replace(
                p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value',
                '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
            ) AS DOUBLE
```sql
        ) AS prevailing,
        p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'Ernst & Young U.S. LLP'
      AND strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        headct,
        LEAST(
            100.0,
            GREATEST(0.0, 100.0 * (offered / NULLIF(prevailing, 0) - 1))
        ) AS headroom_points,
        CASE wage_level
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25.0
            WHEN 'II' THEN 50.0
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75.0
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100.0
        END AS level_points
    FROM wages
)
SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(headct * (
        (0.6 * headroom_points + 0.4 * level_points)
        - (0.7 * headroom_points + 0.3 * level_points)
    )) / NULLIF(SUM(headct), 0),
    2
) AS score_change
FROM scores
WHERE headroom_points IS NOT NULL
  AND level_points IS NOT NULL;
```

```sql
annual_wages AS (
    SELECT
        headct,
        offered_amount * CASE offered_unit
            WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS aow,
        prevailing_amount * CASE prevailing_unit
            WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
        END AS apw,
        CASE wage_level
            WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50

),

    FROM annual_wages
)

    SUM(headct * (0.1 * (level_points - headroom_points))) / SUM(headct),

) AS score_change
```

    FROM cases c

```sql
    WHERE strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-06-01'

),

                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12

case_scores AS (
```

```sql
WITH jan_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value,
        r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        q.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        c.seg_category AS customer_segment,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.profilenum, DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(r.revdate AS DATE))
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE c.profilenum = 'CUS00032'
      AND CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2025-02-01'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        j.casenum,
        j.unit_value,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY j.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    (rr.customer_segment <> 'ANY')::INT
                    + (rr.return_channel <> 'ANY')::INT
                    + (rr.item_category <> 'ANY')::INT
                    + (rr.primary_reason <> 'ANY')::INT
                    + (rr.item_condition <> 'ANY')::INT
                    + (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL)::INT
                    + (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL)::INT
                ) DESC,
                rr.rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM jan_returns j
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules rr
        ON (rr.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR rr.customer_segment = j.customer_segment)
       AND (rr.return_channel = 'ANY' OR rr.return_channel = j.return_channel)
       AND (rr.item_category = 'ANY' OR rr.item_category = j.itemcategory)
       AND (rr.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR rr.primary_reason = j.primary_reason)
       AND (rr.item_condition = 'ANY' OR rr.item_condition = j.item_condition)
       AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR j.monthly_returns >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
       AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR j.monthly_returns <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(SUM(
        COALESCE(flat_charge, 0)
        + unit_value * COALESCE(charge_pct, 0) / 100.0
    ), 0),
    2
) AS total_rhc
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
```

For cases starting in January 2024, the average Case Wage Assurance Score was **33.77** for H-1B dependent cases and **42.60** for non-dependent cases. Each case is weighted equally; cases with a missing dependency flag are excluded.

```sql
WITH wages AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) AS dependent,
        CAST(
            REPLACE(REPLACE(p.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.from', '$', ''), ',', '')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) * CASE p.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.unit'
              WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
              WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
              WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
              WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS aow,
        CAST(
            REPLACE(REPLACE(p.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) * CASE p.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.unit'
              WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
              WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
              WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
              WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS apw,
        p.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', STRPTIME(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) = DATE '2024-01-01'
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        dependent,
        0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
        + 0.3 * CASE wage_level
                  WHEN 'I' THEN 25
                  WHEN 'II' THEN 50
                  WHEN 'III' THEN 75
                  WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
                  ELSE 50
                END AS cwas
    FROM wages
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(cwas) FILTER (WHERE dependent = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
    ROUND(AVG(cwas) FILTER (WHERE dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM scores;
```

The total Return Handling Charge is **535.36**. The query uses the return processing date to identify 2025 returns, applies the most specific matching rule to each return, and treats returns with no matching rule as a zero charge.

```sql
WITH customer_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value,
        r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        q.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        c.seg_category,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.profilenum, DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(r.revdate AS DATE))
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE c.profilenum = 'CUS00104'
      AND r.revdate >= '2025-01-01'
      AND r.revdate < '2026-01-01'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        b.unit_value,
        cr.flat_charge,
        cr.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CAST(cr.customer_segment <> 'ANY' AS INTEGER) +
                    CAST(cr.return_channel <> 'ANY' AS INTEGER) +
                    CAST(cr.item_category <> 'ANY' AS INTEGER) +
                    CAST(cr.primary_reason <> 'ANY' AS INTEGER) +
                    CAST(cr.item_condition <> 'ANY' AS INTEGER)
                ) DESC NULLS LAST,
                (
                    CAST(cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER) +
                    CAST(cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL AS INTEGER)
                ) DESC NULLS LAST,
                cr.rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM customer_returns b
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules cr
        ON (cr.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR cr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
       AND (cr.return_channel = 'ANY' OR cr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
       AND (cr.item_category = 'ANY' OR cr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
       AND (cr.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR cr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
       AND (cr.item_condition = 'ANY' OR cr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
       AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_returns >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
       AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_returns <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
)
SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(COALESCE(flat_charge, 0) + unit_value * COALESCE(charge_pct, 0) / 100),
    2
) AS total_rhc
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rn = 1;
```

For each February return, the query selects the most specific applicable charge rule, breaking ties by the lowest `rule_id`. It then adds the flat charge and the percentage of the product’s unit value.

```sql
WITH february_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        o.buyerlink AS customer_id,
        c.seg_category,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value,
        r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        q.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.buyerlink) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE r.revdate >= '2025-02-01'
      AND r.revdate < '2025-03-01'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        f.casenum,
        f.customer_id,
        f.unit_value,
        cr.flat_charge,
        cr.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY f.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN cr.item_category <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                           OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                cr.rule_id
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM february_returns f
    JOIN return_charge_rules cr
      ON (cr.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR cr.customer_segment = f.seg_category)
     AND (cr.return_channel = 'ANY' OR cr.return_channel = f.return_channel)
     AND (cr.item_category = 'ANY' OR cr.item_category = f.itemcategory)
     AND (cr.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR cr.primary_reason = f.primary_reason)
     AND (cr.item_condition = 'ANY' OR cr.item_condition = f.item_condition)
     AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR f.monthly_returns >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL
          OR f.monthly_returns <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    ROUND(SUM(flat_charge + unit_value * charge_pct / 100), 2) AS total_rhc
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rule_rank = 1
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_rhc DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 5;
```

        q.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
```sql
        COUNT(*) OVER (
```
```sql
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, SUBSTR(r.revdate, 1, 7)
```
```sql
        ) AS monthly_returns
```
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
```sql
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
```
```sql
    WHERE c.profilenum = 'CUS00016'
      AND r.revdate >= '2025-01-01'
      AND r.revdate < '2026-01-01'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        cr.return_month,
        cr.casenum,
        cr.unit_value,
        rules.flat_charge,
        rules.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cr.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN rules.customer_segment NOT IN ('ANY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rules.return_channel NOT IN ('ANY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rules.item_category NOT IN ('ANY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rules.primary_reason NOT IN ('ANY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rules.item_condition NOT IN ('ANY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                (
                    CASE WHEN rules.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN rules.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                rules.rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM customer_returns cr
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules rules
        ON (rules.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR rules.customer_segment = cr.seg_category)
       AND (rules.return_channel = 'ANY' OR rules.return_channel = cr.return_channel)
       AND (rules.item_category = 'ANY' OR rules.item_category = cr.itemcategory)
       AND (rules.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR rules.primary_reason = cr.primary_reason)

       AND (rules.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR cr.monthly_returns >= rules.min_monthly_returns)

)
```

```sql
WITH return_base AS (

        r.casenum,

        r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.profilenum, SUBSTR(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE r.revdate >= '2025-01-01'
      AND r.revdate < '2026-01-01'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        b.seg_category,
        b.unit_value,
        cr.flat_charge,
        cr.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN cr.return_channel <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN cr.item_category <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN cr.item_condition <> 'ANY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

                ) DESC NULLS LAST,
                cr.rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM return_base b
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules cr
```

The calculation uses the lowest-ID matching rule for each return, or the standard charge when no rule matches.

```sql
WITH return_base AS (
    SELECT
        r.revdate,
        r.return_channel,
        c.seg_category,
        p.itemcategory,
        CAST(p.unit_value AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS unit_value,
        (r.return_details -> 'reasoning' ->> 'primary_reason') AS primary_reason,
        (q.assessment_summary -> 'condition' ->> 'item_condition') AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, SUBSTR(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS monthly_return_count
    FROM returns AS r
    JOIN orders AS o ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
    JOIN customers AS c ON o.buyerlink = c.profilenum
    JOIN products AS p ON r.itemlink = p.itemcode
    JOIN quality_assessment AS q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),
charges AS (
    SELECT
        b.revdate,
        b.seg_category,
        COALESCE(rule.flat_charge, 15.00)
            + COALESCE(rule.charge_pct, 5.0) / 100 * b.unit_value AS rhc
    FROM return_base AS b
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cr.flat_charge, cr.charge_pct
        FROM return_charge_rules AS cr
        WHERE (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = 'ANY'
               OR cr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
          AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = 'ANY'
               OR cr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
          AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = 'ANY'
               OR cr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
          AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = 'ANY'
               OR cr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
          AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = 'ANY'
               OR cr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
          AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL
               OR cr.min_monthly_returns <= b.monthly_return_count)
          AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL
               OR cr.max_monthly_returns >= b.monthly_return_count)
        ORDER BY cr.rule_id
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS rule ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    seg_category,
    ROUND(AVG(rhc), 2) AS avg_rhc
FROM charges
WHERE revdate >= '2025-01-01'
  AND revdate < '2026-01-01'
  AND seg_category IN ('Retail', 'Wholesale')
GROUP BY seg_category
ORDER BY seg_category;
```

For February 2025, customer CUS00080 has **leakage_class = High** and **clr = 0.85**. This treats leakage as the portion of rule-based handling charges not covered by recorded restocking fees.

```sql
WITH monthly_cases AS (
    SELECT
        c.profilenum,
        c.seg_category,
        r.casenum,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value::DOUBLE AS unit_value,
        r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        q.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.profilenum) AS monthly_returns
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.buyerlink = c.profilenum
    JOIN returns r ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE c.profilenum = 'CUS00080'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-02-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        m.casenum,
        COALESCE(cr.flat_charge, 0)
            + m.unit_value * COALESCE(cr.charge_pct, 0) / 100.0
            AS expected_charge,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment = m.seg_category THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel = m.return_channel THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN cr.item_category = m.itemcategory THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason = m.primary_reason THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition = m.item_condition THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                cr.rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM monthly_cases m
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules cr
      ON (cr.customer_segment = m.seg_category OR cr.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR cr.customer_segment IS NULL)
     AND (cr.return_channel = m.return_channel OR cr.return_channel = 'ANY' OR cr.return_channel IS NULL)
     AND (cr.item_category = m.itemcategory OR cr.item_category = 'ANY' OR cr.item_category IS NULL)
     AND (cr.primary_reason = m.primary_reason OR cr.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR cr.primary_reason IS NULL)
     AND (cr.item_condition = m.item_condition OR cr.item_condition = 'ANY' OR cr.item_condition IS NULL)
     AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m.monthly_returns >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m.monthly_returns <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(GREATEST(
            COALESCE(rr.expected_charge, 0)
              - COALESCE(TRY_CAST(f.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS DOUBLE), 0),
            0
        )) AS leaked_charge,
        SUM(COALESCE(rr.expected_charge, 0)) AS expected_charge
    FROM ranked_rules rr
    LEFT JOIN financial_management f ON f.casetag = rr.casenum
    WHERE rr.rn = 1
),
ratio AS (
    SELECT leaked_charge / NULLIF(expected_charge, 0) AS clr
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN clr >= 0.5 THEN 'High'
        WHEN clr >= 0.2 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS leakage_class,
    ROUND(clr, 2) AS clr
FROM ratio;
```

**22** performance snapshots taken in 2020 have a calculated Warranty Settlement Amount above $3,000. The query treats the amount as the fixed fee plus the covered percentage of replacement cost, using the most specific matching rule.

```sql
WITH snapshot_data AS (
    SELECT
        r.snapkey,
        r.snapts,
        p.cap_mw,
        p.warrstate,
        m.makertag,
        m.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        o.replcost,
        SUM(COALESCE(p.warrclaims, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.makertag, DATE_TRUNC('month', r.snapts)
        ) AS monthly_claims
    FROM plant_record AS r
    JOIN plants AS p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models AS m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert AS a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics AS o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly_claims <= 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN monthly_claims <= 4 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM snapshot_data
    WHERE snapts >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND snapts < DATE '2021-01-01'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        c.snapkey,
        c.replcost,
        w.fixed_fee_usd,
        w.cover_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    (w.maker_tag <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
                  + (w.pnl_kind <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
                  + (w.alrt_state <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
                  + (w.warr_state <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
                  + (w.cap_band <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
                  + (w.vol_tier <> 'ALL')::INTEGER
                ) DESC,
                w.rule_id
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM classified AS c
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules AS w
      ON (w.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR w.maker_tag = c.makertag)
     AND (w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR w.pnl_kind = c.pnlkind)
     AND (w.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR w.alrt_state = c.alrtstate)
     AND (w.warr_state = 'ALL' OR w.warr_state = c.warrstate)
     AND (w.cap_band = 'ALL' OR w.cap_band = c.cap_band)
     AND (w.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR w.vol_tier = c.vol_tier)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS snapshots
FROM ranked_rules
WHERE rule_rank = 1
  AND fixed_fee_usd + replcost * cover_pct / 100.0 > 3000;
```

      ELSE 'Bulk'
    END AS vol_tier
```sql
  FROM main.plant_record r
  LEFT JOIN main.plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
  LEFT JOIN main.panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
  LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
  LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
```
```sql
),
```
```sql
st AS (
  SELECT
    s.snapkey,
```
```sql
    s.snapts,
```
```sql
    s.replcost,
    w.rule_id,
```
```sql
    w.fixed_fee_usd,
```
```sql
    w.cover_pct
  FROM s
  LEFT JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
    ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR w.maker_tag = s.makertag)
   AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR w.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
   AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR w.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
   AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = 'ALL' OR w.warr_state = s.warrstate)
   AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = 'ALL' OR w.cap_band = s.cap_band)
   AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR w.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY s.snapkey
    ORDER BY
      (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
       + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
       + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
       + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
       + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
       + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) DESC,
      w.rule_id ASC
  ) = 1
),
amounts AS (
  SELECT
    st.rule_id,
    COALESCE(st.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00)
      + COALESCE(st.cover_pct, 5.00) / 100.0
        * COALESCE(CAST(st.replcost AS DOUBLE), 0) AS amount
  FROM st
  WHERE st.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'
    AND st.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rule_id IS NULL THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0),
    2
  ) AS standard_share_pct
FROM amounts
```

The query selects the most specific matching settlement rule for each snapshot and treats snapshots with no matching rule as a $0 settlement.

```sql
WITH snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        r.snapkey,
        date_trunc('month', r.snapts) AS claim_month,
        pm.makertag,
        pm.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        p.warrstate,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        COALESCE(p.warrclaims, 0) AS claim_count,
        o.replcost
    FROM plant_record r
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
    WHERE r.snapts >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND r.snapts < DATE '2022-01-01'
),
tiers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(claim_count) OVER (
                PARTITION BY makertag, claim_month
            ) <= 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN SUM(claim_count) OVER (
                PARTITION BY makertag, claim_month
            ) <= 4 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM snapshots
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        t.snapkey,
        t.vol_tier,
        t.replcost,
        w.fixed_fee_usd,
        w.cover_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN w.maker_tag <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN w.alrt_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN w.warr_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN w.cap_band <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                    CASE WHEN w.vol_tier <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC NULLS LAST,
                w.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM tiers t
    LEFT JOIN warranty_settle_rules w
        ON (w.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
       AND (w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
       AND (w.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
       AND (w.warr_state = 'ALL' OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
       AND (w.cap_band = 'ALL' OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
       AND (w.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
)
SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            COALESCE(fixed_fee_usd, 0)
            + COALESCE(replcost, 0) * COALESCE(cover_pct, 0) / 100.0
```

```sql
            WHEN cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
        END AS cap_band
    FROM base
),
settled AS (
    SELECT
        t.snapts,
        t.vol_tier,
        COALESCE(w.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00)
          + COALESCE(w.cover_pct, 5.00) / 100.0
            * COALESCE(t.replcost, 0) AS settlement_usd
    FROM tiered t
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT w.rule_id, w.fixed_fee_usd, w.cover_pct
        FROM warranty_settle_rules w
        WHERE (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
          AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
          AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
          AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = 'ALL' OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
          AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = 'ALL' OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
          AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
        ORDER BY
            (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL AND w.maker_tag <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL AND w.pnl_kind <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL AND w.alrt_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL AND w.warr_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL AND w.cap_band <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL AND w.vol_tier <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
            w.rule_id ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) w ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(settlement_usd), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM settled
WHERE snapts >= DATE '2021-01-01'
  AND snapts < DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
```

WITH base AS (

```sql
        END AS cap_band,
```

```sql
    FROM plant_record r
```

```sql
            PARTITION BY b.maker_group, b.claim_month

),
snapshots AS (

        v.alrtstate, v.warrstate, v.replcost, v.cap_band,
```

```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        pr.snapts,
        pm.makertag,
        pm.pnlkind,
        p.warrstate,
        a.alrtstate,
        p.cap_mw,
        o.replcost,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.snapts),
                         COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted')
        ) AS monthly_volume
    FROM plant_record pr
    LEFT JOIN plants p ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
    LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON p.modhook = pm.modkey
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = pr.snapkey
),
tiered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            WHEN cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN monthly_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM base
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd,
        r.cover_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.snapkey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL AND r.maker_tag <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL AND r.pnl_kind <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL AND r.alrt_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NOT NULL AND r.warr_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.cap_band IS NOT NULL AND r.cap_band <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL AND r.vol_tier <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM tiered t
    LEFT JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
        ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR r.maker_tag = t.makertag)
       AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR r.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
       AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = 'ALL' OR r.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
       AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = 'ALL' OR r.warr_state = t.warrstate)
       AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = 'ALL' OR r.cap_band = t.cap_band)
       AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR r.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
)
SELECT
    vol_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            COALESCE(fixed_fee_usd, 300.0)
            + COALESCE(cover_pct, 5.0) / 100.0 * COALESCE(replcost, 0)
        ),
        2
    ) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND snapts >= DATE '2021-01-01'
  AND snapts < DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
GROUP BY vol_tier
ORDER BY vol_tier;
```

Using snapshots with both power readings available, TOPCon panels were in the **Medium** energy loss band in July 2019, with a technology monthly energy loss ratio of **5.78%**. The query uses bands of Low (<5%), Medium (5%–<10%), and High (≥10%).

```sql
WITH snapshot_power AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.power.power_now_w') AS DOUBLE) AS power_now_w,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.power.power_loss_w') AS DOUBLE) AS power_loss_w
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pm.pnlkind = 'TOPCon'
      AND pr.snapts >= DATE '2019-07-01'
      AND pr.snapts < DATE '2019-08-01'
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        100.0 * SUM(power_loss_w)
        / NULLIF(SUM(power_now_w + power_loss_w), 0) AS ratio_pct
    FROM snapshot_power
    WHERE power_now_w IS NOT NULL
      AND power_loss_w IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN ratio_pct < 5 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN ratio_pct < 10 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS loss_band,
    ROUND(ratio_pct, 2) AS loss_ratio_pct
FROM monthly;
```

```sql
    FROM snapshot_yields
```

```sql
            FILTER (WHERE potential_kwh IS NOT NULL)
            / NULLIF(SUM(potential_kwh), 0) AS ratio
    FROM potentials
    GROUP BY month
)

    ROUND(ratio, 2) AS loss_ratio_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN ratio < 6 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN ratio < 10 THEN 'Moderate'
        WHEN ratio < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
```
